* **Développer et activer des relations de confiance :** vous prospectez activement, entretenez les contacts existants et réactivez les prospects – qu’il s’agisse d’indépendants, d’entrepreneurs ou d’entreprises – afin de générer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales.

* **Maximiser la valeur de chaque relation :** vous réalisez des ventes croisées (cross-selling) et incitatives (up-selling) en collaboration avec nos business units, afin d’offrir une approche globale et cohérente aux clients.
* **Jouer un rôle de passerelle interne :** vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos consultants, delivery managers et product specialists, et accompagnez le processus d’onboarding pour garantir une expérience client optimale.
* **Définir et exécuter votre plan d’action commercial :** vous mettez en place votre propre plan de vente, suivez vos objectifs et contribuez activement à la croissance de Group S.

* Expérience avérée dans un rôle de développement commercial et vente B2B.
* Connaissance de base de la législation sociale belge.
* Excellentes capacités de communication, d'organisation et de prise d’initiative.
* Une maîtrise des outils CRM et des processus commerciaux est un atout. Connaissance de Microsoft dynamics est un atout.
* Vous êtes convaincant, orienté résultat et disposez de solides compétences en négociation.
* Vous disposez d’une excellente maîtrise du néerlandais, toute autre langue est un atout.

#### **Qui sommes-nous ?**

Chez Group S, nous sommes bien plus qu’un secrétariat social. Forts de **80 ans d’expertise** et de l'engagement de **750 collègues passionnés**, nous accompagnons les entreprises dans toutes les étapes de leur croissance. Notre mission : **conjuguer innovation, expertise et proximité** pour répondre aux défis RH d’aujourd’hui et de demain.

#### **Pourquoi rejoindre Group S ?**

Chez Group S, on ne vous propose pas seulement un poste : on vous offre un environnement stimulant, bienveillant et aligné avec vos besoins.

* **Un cadre de travail humain et motivant :** entraide, respect, progression — ici, la bienveillance est vécue au quotidien.
* **Un onboarding et une formation sur-mesure** dès votre arrivée pour bien démarrer et évoluer à votre rythme.

* **Un package attractif et modulable :** salaire compétitif, plan cafeteria, frais nets, bonus.

Dans ce cas, posez votre candidature ici ! Nous nous réjouissons d'avance de pouvoir faire votre connaissance !

You join a close-knit, engineering-driven team. You are the bridge between our clients’ business needs and our technical experts, who support you in shaping strong proposals. By finding new opportunities, moving into new sectors and strengthening Cyclops’ visibility in the market, you play a key role in writing the next chapter of our growth.

**ABOUT THE JOB**

As Business Development Manager, you are the driving force behind expanding our presence in the industrial market. By developing business with both existing and prospective clients and collaborating with a team of account managers, you define and execute our commercial vision.

* Drive business growth by actively identifying new clients and project opportunities. You build your own prospecting approach and bring fresh ideas to open up markets.

* Broaden our client base, build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers at clients, on the technical side as well as at management and procurement level.
* Steer the commercial organisation and align the account managers. Set up and follow-up the commercial priorities and deadlines and make sure the account managers are aligned in the approach
* Translate client needs, together with our engineers and project managers, into a feasible and differentiating offer.
* Prepare compelling proposals, lead negotiations and close contracts.
* Stay on top of industry trends, Capex cycles and market demand, and turn them into a commercial plan.

* Take ownership of the sales meetings by leading the discussion, defining the agenda, and driving the content.
* When onboarding a new client, ensure you have a thorough understanding of the project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
* Report on pipeline, forecast and results to the General Manager and in the management meetings.

**WHAT WE NEED**

* At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales of projects or project-based services (project management, engineering, EPC, construction, technical services). You understand the dynamics of a project-based environment.
* Technical background or strong technical insight: you understand what the industry is about, can discuss solutions and content with engineers and clients, and can assess the scope of a project.
* Proven success in managing complex sales cycles and closing high-value deals (be ready to share concrete examples).
* Assertive and persuasive: you take the lead in an environment where sales is spread across several account managers, and you create buy-in without relying on authority.
* Proactive and entrepreneurial: you enjoy prospecting and bring your own ideas for winning new clients and markets.
* Excellent negotiation, presentation and communication skills in Dutch, French and English.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking to develop and follow up commercial plans.
* Willingness to travel around Belgium for client meetings and events.

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

* Cyclops is an open, dynamic and fast-growing company which offers you a challenging job with direct responsibility for varying projects.
* The collaboration can be structured as a service agreement, which offers flexibility and autonomy

* We provide coaching, trainings and courses to improve your skills and to develop you into a project professional.
* As we grow as a company, we enable you to grow in your profession.
* Last but not least: If you want to combine fun and challenges, Cyclops is the place to be!

Interested or want more information? Feel free to send us a mail or apply with your CV and we’ll contact you as soon as possible!

job.title: Business Development Manager @ ChainCraft (Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
Business Development Managers in specialty chemicals are often drawn to the challenge of building something new. At ChainCraft, the novelty is in our production process, which is more sustainable and resilient. With our own process we produce drop-in chemicals: molecules identical to their fossil and palm-based counterparts, for which you will build new business, both for existing and new applications. You decide how to do so, and the customers you bring in will help shape the first full scale production plant we build.

ChainCraft turns agrifood residues into biobased short-chain fatty acids, a circular alternative to ingredients that still come from fossil sources and palm oil. Our demo plant in Amsterdam has been running for six years today. In 2027 we start building our first full scale commercial plant in Ter Apelkanaal, the Netherlands, backed by more than €40 million in European, national and regional grants. We are looking for a Business Development Manager to expand our position with international customers, mainly in home & personal care.

What a scale up gives you: an energizing work environment, the independence to build your own sector, a positive story to sell to clients, and a direct line to the people who decide. Short lines, few layers of management between you and a decision. What it asks of you: nobody sets up your meetings and there is no large marketing machine behind you. You find out who you need to talk to, you find your way to them, and you reach out yourself.

**Your role**

Your first priority is new business. You find the companies in home & personal care that can use our short-chain fatty acids, reach the people who make the decisions, and take them from a first conversation to sample, trial and project. Your second priority is growing what is already there: you take over around twenty active accounts and build them into a pipeline for the short and medium term. So you don’t start from scratch, but the sector is yours to build.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Open new business:**
  identify which companies can use our fatty acids and who decides there. Through your network, LinkedIn or a direct call, you get a seat at the table.

* **Grow your accounts:**
  take over around twenty active accounts and move each one forward, from sample to trial to project. From new contract to trusted partner.

* **Set your own course:**
  decide where to focus, capture it in a plan the team can follow, and carry it out. You report to Jeroen van Dorp, Head of Business Development, who is also your sparring partner.

* **Negotiate and close:**
  lead the commercial process from first contact to signed contract. You negotiate pricing and terms within an agreed range, with a final review before signing.

* **Shape what we develop:**
  your customer insight is the input for our Application Specialist. What you hear in the market determines which applications we develop next.

* **Represent ChainCraft:**
  at trade shows, conferences and on site with customers, building the network that brings in the next opportunity.

Most of your customers are outside the Netherlands, and you spend at least a quarter of your time travelling. When you are not travelling, you work from our Amsterdam office three days a week.

**About you**

You know chemistry well enough to hold your own with the customer’s R&D team, and you know business well enough to tell when a conversation is going somewhere. You don't wait for an introduction. **Location:**
Amsterdam, Netherlands

European Business

The steel in your building, the fries with your burger, the paper in your notebook: almost everything around you needed industrial heat to make. Today most of that heat still comes from burning fossil fuels. We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to help us deliver the projects that change that, making industrial heat clean, reliable and affordable.

**About Good Heat**

Good Heat is accelerating the global transition to clean, affordable, electrified heat. By deploying electrified thermal energy solutions (the fancy term for heat batteries), we unlock decarbonisation at industrial scale, alongside resilience and cost efficiency.

We develop, finance, build, own and operate industrial scale heat infrastructure that allows manufacturers to replace fossil fuels with low cost renewable electricity. Our industrial and commercial customers receive clean heat cheaper than gas, with zero capital investment.

We operate across Europe and Australia, with a rapidly growing footprint and a small, high ownership team. Since the launch of the company last year, we have built a European pipeline of over 100MWt, secured structured partnerships with leading energy companies, and led the development of Project Arcadia, the largest eTES project in Australia, which is set to reach financial close in H1 2027.

Read more about our latest funding round here: https://www.goodheat.energy/news-insights/good-heat-raises-eu2m-from-set-ventures-and-shell-ventures-to-scale-heat-battery-solutions-for-industrial-heating-across-europe

**The Role**

As Business Development Manager, you will be responsible for finding Good Heat’s next customers, progressing prospective customers through Good Heat’s initial screening process and converting qualified opportunities into feasibility studies.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role. Success depends on identifying the right customers, quickly distinguishing attractive opportunities from unsuitable ones, and maintaining momentum through to a clear commitment to undertake feasibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Origination**

* Shape Good Heat’s origination strategy: which markets, sectors, regions and priority customers to pursue, and how to grow them into long-term partners.
* Identify and engage prospective industrial customers with significant heat demand and potential for electrification.
* Build relationships with relevant decision-makers across operations, engineering, energy procurement, sustainability and management.
* Build partnerships that help Good Heat reach new customers and grow the business.

**Customer Screening and Qualification**

* Lead the initial screening of prospective customers, gathering key information such as heat demand, temperature requirements, operating profiles, current fuel sources, energy costs and site characteristics.
* Evaluate the potential commercial attractiveness of opportunities, including indicative project economics and customer appetite for a long-term heat supply arrangement.
* Identify key technical, commercial, credit and site constraints that could prevent an opportunity from progressing.

**Conversion to Feasibility**

* Lead customer engagement from initial screening to a formal feasibility study, building confidence in Good Heat’s solution and the value of feasibility.
* Agree the scope, objectives, information requirements and next steps for feasibility studies in collaboration with the development and technical teams.
* Secure customer cooperation and the necessary commitments to enable feasibility work to commence.
* Support the preparation and negotiation of proposals and agreements.

* Maintain an accurate, prioritised pipeline, tracking opportunity status, key assumptions, conversion rates, expected timelines and next actions.
* Report regularly on pipeline performance and use the results to improve screening and conversion.
* Ensure a smooth handover to project development, with customer requirements, commercial assumptions and risks clearly documented.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in business development, sales, commercial origination or customer acquisition in a B2B environment.
* Demonstrated ability to engage customers, qualify opportunities and progress commercial discussions towards tangible outcomes.
* Strong commercial judgement and the ability to assess whether an opportunity merits further investment of time and resources.
* Ability to understand customer operating requirements and commercial drivers, and communicate a compelling value proposition.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to work with energy consumption data, indicative economics and business cases.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building and negotiation skills.
* Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and maintain momentum across a pipeline.
* Experience with industrial customers, energy, infrastructure, industrial technology or complex technical solutions is a plus.
* Professional fluency in English. Dutch or German is an advantage.

**Working Arrangement**

* Full time, 5 days a week (38 hours)
* Hybrid: typically, 3 days in the Amsterdam office, 2 days from home
* Start date: February 2027
* 65K-85KEUR + 9% pension + additional incentives and benefits
* 25 annual leave days

**What We Offer**

* A mission with real impact: your work directly supports the rollout of clean, electrified heat across Europe and Australia
* A small, dynamic, high ownership team where your contributions shape how we scale
* Early entry into a fast-growing business with an opportunity to help build an entirely new industry
* Work closely with our senior leadership, giving you visibility, influence and the ability to shape how we deliver
* A culture built on openness, honesty and mutual respect - we work with people who elevate the team, not egos
* We trust you - hybrid working with the flexibility to manage your office/home days, as long as it works for your team too
* We strongly support work/life balance - manage your hours and balance your 38 hour week, as long as the work gets done
* Competitive employment package with above market leave policies
* Real room to grow, with your responsibilities expanding as we scale and regular salary reviews to match
* A lovely central office environment, a short tram or bike ride from Centraal
* Work in a diverse international team, with regular interaction with our Sydney office

If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply through the Homerun link below. We value diverse perspectives and welcome candidates from all backgrounds who believe they can excel in this role. As a small team that works closely together, we care as much about communication and fit as we do about ticking every box, so if you're excited about the role but don't meet every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you. We recommend your cover letter addresses your communication and stakeholder management skills, cultural fit and business development experience.

Applications close on 29 January 2027. We will review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so if the role interests you, it's worth applying early rather than waiting for the deadline. Interviews will be with our Head of Business Operations, Director of Energy & Technology and CEO. We are aiming for a start date in late February, with flexibility for notice periods.

job.title: Founder Associate – Business Development & Strategy (f/m/d) @ LiveEO GmbH (Berlin, BE, DE)
job.description:
#### **Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO**

LiveEO monitors the world's critical infrastructure from space. Infrastructure operators on five continents use our satellite and AI platform to monitor more than one million miles of power lines, railways and pipelines. In 2026 we closed the first €28M+ of our current funding round, with new investors including the European Innovation Council and the defence fund Helantic, bringing total funding to more than €72M. We are now building Twinspector, our own satellite constellation for infrastructure monitoring, backed by the European Space Agency, and expanding into defence. You'll join just as we're scaling revenue, raising further capital and putting our own satellites into orbit.

#### **Your challenge**

As Founder Associate, you are an extension of our Co-CEO. You think like him, act on his behalf and multiply his impact across the company. You take entire topics off his desk: opening new markets for our products, supporting our fundraising and shaping company strategy, and representing him towards investors, customers, partners and other senior stakeholders.

This is a high-trust role with a direct view into how a scaling company is built and financed, from finding new markets we can sell into to financing the company and building our own satellite constellation. We are an agentic-AI-first company: AI agents are part of how every team works, and you will use them every day to move faster and deliver more.

**Who you'll work with**

* You work directly with the Co-CEO and represent him towards investors, customers, partners and internal teams.
* You partner with the Chief of Staff on strategically relevant projects.
* You coordinate between the board, investors and internal teams.
* You hand new markets over to the sales team once they work and are repeatable.

**Tools you'll use**

* Google Suite (Sheets, Slides)
* AI tools and agents, used daily to research, analyse, write and automate work

#### **Your profile**

* Find new markets for our existing products: identify any customer group willing to pay, whether municipalities, government agencies, utilities or private companies, and take our products there with minimal changes.

* Support our equity and debt fundraising, from investor materials and financial models to the data room and due diligence.
* Prepare and follow up on investor meetings and keep the process moving.

* Own strategic projects on the Co-CEO's behalf, from analysis to implementation.

* Represent the Co-CEO in meetings with investors, customers, partners and internal teams, and at external events.

*Structure and operations*

* Bring structure to the Co-CEO's priorities and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between the board, customers, investors and internal teams.
* Do whatever it takes to get things done, including the less glamorous parts.

**What you bring**

*Must have*

* An excellent master's degree in business, economics or a related field.
* First professional experience (ideally 1–3 years) in management consulting, investment banking or private equity/VC, or at a high-growth scale-up or start-up (e.g. in strategy, business development or a founder's office role). Outstanding graduates with relevant internships in these areas are also welcome.
* A track record of having sold or built something: a venture you started, a deal you closed or a client you won. Tell us about it in your application.
* An exceptional work ethic: you go the extra mile and hold yourself to extremely high standards.
* Ownership and initiative: you see what needs doing and drive it forward without being asked.
* Confidence in front of senior stakeholders: you can represent the company credibly towards customers, investors and partners.
* Expert use of AI tools and agents: you already use them daily to research, analyse, write and automate your work, and you actively look for new ways to apply them.
* A strong analytical mindset, solid Sheets and Slides skills, and the ability to get into new topics quickly. No technical background is required.
* A challenge mentality: you push back constructively when something doesn't add up, including towards the Co-CEO.
* Clear and succinct communication, written and spoken.
* Comfort with ambiguity, a structured way of working and a focus on outcomes.
* Sound judgement and absolute discretion with confidential information.
* Based in Berlin and regularly in our Cuvrystraße office. The role is hybrid, but it relies on close, in-person work with the Co-CEO, sometimes at short notice.
* Fluent German (C2 level) and excellent English, written and spoken.

*Nice to have*

* Exposure to fundraising, M&A or financing transactions.
* Experience in B2B sales or business development, ideally with enterprise or public-sector clients.
* Interest in space, earth observation or the government and defence sector.

#### **Your Benefits**

* Hybrid working from our office at Cuvrystraße in Berlin-Kreuzberg
* A subsidised public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket Job or VBB/BVG ticket)

* An international team working on infrastructure monitoring from space, including our own satellite constellation

LiveEO is a well funded startup founded in 2018 and based in Berlin. Our primary service is modelling risk to our customers’ assets and infrastructure from vegetation, ground deformation and change detection. We currently have around 160 employees from all over the world with a variety of backgrounds

### **Description**

**This is where your next chapter begins.**  
  
We are growing our **Business Development team** within the **AssetOps** **Team** at osapiens, with a focus on Benelux, UK, Ireland & the Nordics, and we are looking for sharp, experienced BDRs. Not the loudest. The sharpest.

This is not a traditional SDR role. It is a high-ownership position at one of Europe’s fastest-growing sustainability tech companies — with a clear career path, an AI-first toolstack, and real responsibility from day one. You will be responsible for our **Maintenance solution (CMMS)** in these markets. Feel free to check out our CMMS website for a deeper understanding.

We are building a decacorn here. You could be part of that.  
  
**What the role looks like**

The role is built on a simple principle: real ownership from day one, with a clear path forward.

You will spend your first year building pipeline, mastering senior outbound, and developing your AI stack. You bring BDR experience already, so we expect you to hit the ground running and to help raise the bar for the whole team. Strong performers can expect significant career opportunities into Account Executive, Senior BD, BD leadership, or adjacent commercial roles, based on your results and where your strengths take you.

### **What you'll do**

  

* **A named-account list.** 100–200 accounts in your territory — you know them, you research them, and you decide when and how to engage. Quality of pipeline, not dial volume. And if you can demonstrate you can handle more, you’ll get more.
* **Senior outbound conversations.** Get into rooms with VP-level and above in your target accounts. Run sharp, well-prepared discovery calls and concise 5–10-minute product framings when needed.
* **Signal-driven outreach.** Read new site openings, asset investments, leadership moves in operations and maintenance, safety and audit requirements, and product launches and turn them into a reason to reach out today. Signals are surfaced for you; the angle is yours to write. Or even better: build agents that put these signals at your fingertips — and share them with your peers.
* **Qualified pipeline handoff.** Move opportunities through to AE-accepted, BANT-qualified pipeline in HubSpot, with multi-thread coverage across at least two contacts per active account.
* **Your own AI stack.** Live inside Claude, ZoomInfo, Apollo, n8n, Clay, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Build and vibe-code your own lightweight agents and workflows for research, enrichment, drafting, and signal monitoring — then share what works with the team.
* **AI SDRs: pilot, improve, and scale.** We’re actively exploring AI SDRs for both inbound and outbound. You’ll be on the front line — piloting them, training them, stress-testing them, and feeding back what works — helping us build the most AI-advanced BD organisation in the world.
* **A clean execution lane.** Messaging, decks, case studies, and objection-handling guides are supplied by Product Marketing and Pre-Sales. Your job is execution: outreach quality, meeting quality, pipeline quality.

  

### **What you'll bring**

  

* **Proven BDR experience.** Two to four years in a BDR, SDR, or similar outbound-focused role, ideally in B2B software, with a track record of building qualified pipeline and booking senior-level meetings.
* **Intellectually sharp and commercially curious.** You read a regulatory shift or an earnings call and turn it into a reason to reach out today.
* **Innovative, out-of-the-box thinker.** You don’t just run the playbook — you challenge it. Tell us what we should be doing differently, what tools we should be trying, what signals we’re missing, and how we can get better at everything we do. We want operators who make the system smarter, not just keep it running.
* **Comfortable in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.** You can articulate a business problem clearly to a senior executive, and you are eager to learn the software and run short product framings when needed.
* **High energy, resilient, and hungry.** Intrinsically motivated to build a great career. Outbound-heavy role, strong performance culture — we hire people who run toward that, not away from it. This is the single most important attribute.
* **AI-first by default.** You already work fluently with Claude, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and n8n, and you build and vibe-code your own lightweight agents and workflows.
* **Multi-solution fluency.** With CMMS at the core, you are comfortable holding the full picture across other osapiens solutions and connecting them to a customer’s actual business challenge: not pitching features, but framing an answer to the problem they already have.
* **Languages.** Fluent English and native or near-native Dutch or a Nordic language (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish).
* **Industry curiosity.** Exposure to maintenance, industrial, or service-related environments is an advantage.
* **Location**. You are based in Munich, Mannheim, Amsterdam or Madrid or willing to relocate.

**What Success Looks Like (first 12 Months):**

* You own your account list end-to-end - ICP scored, signals live, multi-thread coverage trending up.
* Qualified pipeline created, senior-level meetings, and C-level and operations leadership meetings (COO, CTO, CFO, CEO, Head of Maintenance / Operations) reported weekly and trending up against tier targets.
* ACV won where you are logged as lead source is materially contributing to the territory number.
* A visible log of your own AI experiments — agents built, sequences tried, signals tested — with results shared openly across the BD team.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* A purpose-driven mission tackling complex sustainability challenges whilst working alongside global industry pioneers
* Room for creativity through collaborative teamwork and an open communication culture
* Flexibility and team bonding with our hybrid work options
* Fuel for your growth journey, both personally and professionally
* Sustainable mobility options, promoting eco-friendly commuting solutions
* Fun team events and outings with our global teams

  

### **About osapiens**

**osapiens** is one of Europe's fastest-growing tech companies with an AI platform for compliance and supplier intelligence that enables companies to manage risk and become more resilient. With osapiens’ solutions, companies can verify their products, know their suppliers, trace their goods, own their footprint, and report with confidence, all on a single AI platform.

Founded in Mannheim in 2018, we built the **osapiens HUB**. A **multi-tenant platform** designed to enable cross-company collaboration and AI automation and combines **more than 25 solutions** into seven product suites. These solutions enable companies to centrally manage and automate their supplier relationships, compliance requirements, and global supply chains, as well as optimize their maintenance, service, and distribution processes to improve operational performance and maximize global competitiveness.

What started as a single idea has grown into an operating system trusted by **more than 2,500 customers worldwide**, winning the German Founder's Award in 2022 and reaching unicorn status in January 2026. Headquartered in Mannheim, Germany, we have offices across Europe and the United States, where an **international team of 550+ builders** is shaping what’s next.

**The Position**
----------------

Acting globally and working cross functionally, the Category Manager plays an important role in shaping sourcing strategies that ensure sustainable, competitive supply and high service quality for our interventional clinical trials. The role combines strategic responsibility for a global category with active supplier management, stakeholder engagement and continuous improvement of sourcing approaches.

This position can be filled in different countries.

* If you want to apply for the position in UK / Ireland, please use this link: Global Category Manager - Clinical Development
* If you want to apply for the position in Germany, click "Apply now"

In Germany this position has a hybrid setup with approximately 2-3 days per week on site in either Ingelheim or Biberach.

**Tasks & responsibilities**
----------------------------

* You make a significant impact on the success of the Global Sourcing Clinical Development team by applying your strategic strength, persuasiveness and assertiveness. You will be responsible for sourcing activities within global Human Pharma’s clinical services categories.
* You assume responsibility for a worldwide category, managed in a highly centralised manner, by consistently challenging the existing status quo. Identifying enhancements and convincing the upper management to follow new ways of working will be part of your responsibility
* You act as global supplier manager for core service providers, establishing and enforcing a robust governance system to ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.
* One of the key aims of this role is to further develop and strengthen relationships with external strategic partners. In parallel, you closely monitor the market and identify suppliers that best fit business needs.
* You continuously observe supply markets, search for new partners, service providers and solutions, while analysing and mitigating risks within the category.
* You manage a high volume of sourcing requests independently and ensure successful negotiation outcomes. Resulting contracts are managed in close alignment with internal business partners.
* You work closely with cross functional teams to implement cutting edge methods of working and contribute to improvements in speed, cost efficiency, value generation, use of new technologies and optimisation of buying channels

**Requirements**
----------------

This role requires strong experience in global sourcing / procurement within a Pharma, Biotech or Contract Research Organization (CRO) supporting the Clinical Operations function with the outsourcing of trials.

In addition, we are looking for candidates who have:

* Master’s degree in business administration or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification. Candidates with a bachelor's degree combined with relevant professional experience will also be considered
* Knowledge of market intelligence and sourcing practices related to Clinical Development services; experience with running trials in a Fully Outsourced model and with Clinical Pharmacology Units is considered an additional asset – for clarity, this excludes supporting services such as Supply Chain Management, Biomarkers, etc.
* A good understanding of established sourcing methodologies, including demand management, market and supplier analysis, compliance management, due diligence, risk management, supplier relationship management, contract management, and negotiation techniques
* Experience working on international projects and collaborating with cross-functional teams comprising both internal and external stakeholders
* Open‑minded, motivated and persuasive approach, combined with strong internal and external relationship management skills and willingness to take on responsibility
* Team‑oriented mindset with the ability to work collaboratively in diverse, cross‑functional and international teams
* Strong communication skills in English; proficiency in German would be an advantage

Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
